extraction_scope: Mechanism claims bounded to local XML/PDF-derived CD, MD simulation, and docking evidence; computational claims are not promoted to direct wet-lab mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Source-reviewed CD spectroscopy supports alpha-helical structure for synthesized mature Corvus CATH-2 in 50% TFE/water and an unstructured/random coil conformation in water.

method_locators: xml:sec=28:Structural characterization using circular dichroism spectroscopy

mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural support does not by itself prove the killing mechanism in live bacteria.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MD simulations place CATH-2 on bacterial-model mixed membrane and POPC membrane systems and describe hydrogen-bond/membrane contacts involving N-terminal and kink-region residues.

method_locators: xml:sec=26:3D structure prediction and MD simulation

mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational membrane interaction is retained as mechanism context, not promoted to direct experimental killing evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Docking simulation places CATH-2 in the MD-2 LPS-binding pocket of the TLR4-MD-2 complex, suggesting possible LPS/innate-immune modulation context.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=14:Interaction of TLR4 and Corvus CATH-2

mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking is computational and should not be recorded as direct immunomodulatory activity without wet-lab validation.
